title: World definition
description:
AGENTS: before modifying this schema, read AGENTS.md at the repository root.

Defines a single playable sector: its name and the list of entities to spawn via templates. Per ADR-0038, entities are spawned from templates in dependency order. See ADR-0019, ADR-0020, and ADR-0038.

format_version.description: Integer schema version. Must be 1. Increment when the shape changes in a breaking way.

name.description: Human-readable sector name shown in loading screens.

entities.description: Array of entities to spawn from templates (per ADR-0038). Each entry specifies a template reference and instance data. Spawning order is controlled by WorldSpawnSet system sets in domain plugins.

template.description: Short path to the template directory (e.g., ships/debug-ship-cube). The loader resolves this to templates/<path>/<entity_type>.json based on player_controlled flag.

id.description: Unique identifier for this entity instance. Used to reference the entity throughout the game (UI info panels, save/load, networking, etc.). Required; missing id is a hard error (ADR-0013). Must be unique within the world.

position.description: Spawn position in world coordinates (metres). Coordinate system is right-handed, +Y up, -Z forward per ADR-0006.

rotation.description: Optional rotation as a unit quaternion (x, y, z, w). Defaults to identity (no rotation).

scale.description: Optional scale factor (x, y, z). Defaults to (1, 1, 1) (no scaling).

player_controlled.description: If true, the entity is player-controlled. Loads player_controlled_ship.json instead of ship.json and merges with the co-located ship.json. Only valid for ship templates. Exactly one entity in the world must have this set to true.

ai_task.description: Optional AI task assignment. If present, the entity is AI-driven and the loader will load ai_controlled_ship.json and merge with the co-located ship.json. The task determines the AI mission (e.g., 'patrol'). Absent means static ship.

mass.description: Optional mass override. If present, this value overrides the template's mass. Mass is NOT scaled with the scale factor - it is used as-is or overridden. Per ADR-0008, uses value+unit format. Units: kg, t, M_earth, M_sun. Converted to kilograms at load time.

orbital_parameters.description: Optional orbital movement parameters for this entity. If present, the entity will orbit the specified parent body. These parameters are world-specific and override any template defaults.
